items.prompt: The function returns 0.2000 for a synthetic query. Which conclusion stays within the lesson scope?

options.text: The user should immediately risk exactly 20% of real wealth.
options.why: A supplied-probability exercise supplies neither a personal risk policy nor authorization for a transaction.

options.text: The next wager is guaranteed to win.
options.why: The output optimizes a model objective; it does not remove the losing outcome.

options.text: It is a model fraction, not verified real suitability.
options.why: Parameter uncertainty, dependence, costs, liquidity and risk tolerance are outside the bounded exercise.

options.text: The model has measured all fees and correlated exposures.
options.why: Those inputs are absent, so the result cannot establish them.

items.explanation: Parameter uncertainty, dependence, costs, liquidity and risk tolerance are outside the bounded exercise.
